text.offer: The crypt behind my hut was a quiet place, once. Now spectral mummies drift through its first chamber and the villagers won't go near. Clear a dozen of them out of there, so we can see what lies deeper.
text.progress: The crypt's entrance is behind Ran er'Hoth's hut in Marion.
text.complete: Good. The way into the deeper crypt is open now - and I've a mind to send you down it.
